questions.q: How does the data flow engine actually move rows between components?
options: In batches called buffers — blocks of rows processed together, not one row at a time
One row at a time, for maximum accuracy
By writing every row to a temporary SQL Server table first
Only in Chapter 4 transformations, never in sources or destinations
questions.explain: SSIS uses a buffer-oriented architecture: it fills a block of memory with rows and passes that whole buffer down the chain, rather than moving rows individually.

questions.q: What is the default buffer size, and the default maximum rows per buffer?
options: 10,485,760 bytes (10 MB) and 10,000 rows
1 MB and 1,000 rows
100 MB and 1,000,000 rows
There is no default — you must always set it manually
questions.explain: DefaultBufferSize defaults to 10 MB (10,485,760 bytes) and DefaultMaxBufferRows defaults to 10,000 rows.

questions.q: Why does removing unused columns from a data flow improve performance?
options: A buffer holds a fixed number of bytes, so narrower rows let more rows fit in each buffer
SSIS charges a fee per column processed
Fewer columns automatically disables error outputs
It has no real effect on performance, only on readability
questions.explain: Since a buffer's capacity is bytes, not row count, a smaller row width means more rows fit per buffer, and fewer buffers are needed overall.

questions.q: What does a rising "Buffers spooled" performance counter indicate?
options: Buffers are being temporarily written to disk, usually due to insufficient memory
The package completed successfully with no issues
The Data Viewer is currently attached and paused
A source component has run out of rows to extract
questions.explain: Spooling means the buffers can't all fit in memory and are being swapped to disk, which is a clear performance red flag.

questions.q: What does a BufferSizeTuning log entry record?
options: How and why the data flow engine adjusted a buffer's size for that run
The final row count loaded into the destination
A list of every connection manager used by the package
The exact time the package started and finished
questions.explain: BufferSizeTuning entries describe the reasons for a buffer size change and list the resulting temporary buffer size.
